hypotheses.H-controls: Both direct native source candidates equal their actual adapter exits. Copy sham equals zero final latent/PNG; coherent native text-source postblock I/T equals text reference final latent/PNG. KV.image and KV.both install identical I with explicitly different selected T. No historical PNG equality is asserted for new contexts.
hypotheses.H-entry: For every freshly built paired single0 entry, only working T differs; image, latent, stored C0, time/context/modulation/gates/RoPE, positions and schedule are identical. Source image Q/K/V and parallel image MLP preactivation/activation match exactly.
hypotheses.H-generalization: Apply exactly the same source construction and equations to p0-s53,p1-s47,p1-s53 without fitting per-context parameters. p1 seeds47/53 are a within-prompt seed contrast; p0/p1 seed53 are a within-seed prompt contrast. Historical p0 seed47 is separate evidence, not the missing cell of a current exact-code 2x2 cohort. Local equations and forecast errors are tested; endpoint appearances and rankings other than H-text-direction remain exploratory, with reversals retained.
hypotheses.H-local-KV: In each context, KV reproduces text-source image attention dispatch, native fused attention-plus-parallel-MLP image projection, and postblock image exactly; image MLP features stay fixed for all three edits. Candidate postblock T need not equal text-source T. Preserve native fused concat/projection and BF16 arithmetic.
hypotheses.H-numeric-attention: After exactly two native source calls reveal QKV, independently calculate NumPy FP64 softmax attention at the fixed eight image queries, all heads, for K/V/KV. Seal actual numeric predictions and forecast-only text-bank masses before edited calls or adapter prefixes. Compare saved samples with native BF16 dispatch using signed/RMS/max errors without a numerical gate. K and V are novel conditional targets; KV is a represented consistency control. Source-reviewed QKV-only dataflow is not hermetic isolation or an independent MLP/RGB/raw-prompt prediction.
hypotheses.H-scope: Three fresh own-context altered histories. Two unique native prompt encodings, three native seeded noise draws, one resident model, no foreign prompt donor or imported StateCut. Global plan frozen before model load/encoding/noise; each architectural seal follows observed builder prefix; each numerical seal follows exactly two allowed source captures. Nine dependent futures per context do not enumerate every possible future. No universal object dictionary or independent prompt-to-image numerical prediction.
hypotheses.H-selection: K-only changes only positioned text K; V-only only text V; KV both. All edited calls retain recipient Q and image K/V. V-only mathematically preserves attention weights; K-only and KV share weights. A K edit can change normalization over both image and text banks. No ordering among K-only, V-only and KV image endpoints is predicted.
hypotheses.H-text-direction: Tentative cross-context directional prediction: text.text ends closer to the text reference than each of K.image,V.image,KV.image, evaluated separately in final latent L2 and RGB MAE. Retain each signed margin, misses and disagreement between observables. This is a forecast of endpoint distances, not a mediation fraction or semantic prediction.
hypotheses.H-text-policy: K.image/V.image/KV.image retain native zero postblock T. KV.both installs KV candidate T; text.text only native text-source T; coherent text-source I/T. All hybrids start at native zero post-single0, stored C0 unchanged, with no further conditioning projection. The text reference is I0/T1/C0, not the separate own-C joint-prefix result I1/T1/C1.

plan.scope: Fresh connected three-context replication of one final-step single0 K/V law. Per context: native Z2, zero-C history to Z3, paired zero/restored-own-C project+5joint, T-only transplant into I0/C0;96 builder transitions+191 panel transitions,13 Acts,5 direct blocks,9 VAE/finals. Global861 transitions/39 Acts/15 direct/27 VAE. All native futures retained; no semantic gates.

forecast_applicability.formula: softmax(Q K^T / sqrt(128)) V, FP64 stable row-softmax; recipient image Q and image K/V retained; select own-context text K and/or V
forecast_applicability.cast_reference: FP64 -> FP32 -> round-to-nearest-even BF16 expanded to FP32
forecast_applicability.allowed_at_architectural_seal: Global model/encodings/noise and96-transition/three-Act builder observed; zero panel native/Act/VAE work
forecast_applicability.allowed_at_numeric_seal: Exactly two allowed native source direct captures; no edited calls, panel adapter prefixes, Acts or VAE
forecast_applicability.text_mass_status: Predicted only; native probability weights not measured
forecast_applicability.scope: Conditional sampled-attention forecast; no independent raw-prompt, MLP or RGB forecast or hermetic process isolation

countertrends.kind: K-versus-V latent ordering reverses across p1 seeds while RGB favors V at both

limits: No model/kernel replay, new pixels, scheduler submissions or historical-source import by this auditor.
Architecture and dataflow are source-bound trusted worker claims, not hermetic process isolation or independent low-level read traces.
Native continuation arrays and RGB are observations; sampled attention forecasts do not independently predict MLP or final images.
Numerical/endpoint metrics do not certify colors, shapes, object count or prompt semantics.
Three contexts do not support universal generalization or independent replication of each of 27 dependent futures.
